in_sanskrit.meaning: Goddess of knowledge, learning, music, art, wisdom, and beauty

in_marathi.name: Sharha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', which means 'shining', 'radiant', or 'auspicious'. In Hinduism, the goddess Shri, or Lakshmi, is often depicted as a golden, radiant deity, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and good fortune.
